summary.text: Doug Massie is the Republican candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He ran for the Alaska State Senate in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Doug Massie was the Republican candidate in the 2022 general election for Alaska State Senate District O, losing to Mike Shower, 47.0 percent to 51.8 percent.
In 2026 he advanced from the August 18 primary in District 30, where incumbent Kevin McCabe is also on the ballot.
